podcast.title: Atlanta Trap Music and Heavy Metal Hybrid
podcast.body: Trap Metal is a hybrid genre that emerged in the 2010s, combining trap music, a style of hip hop originating from Atlanta, with heavy metal. "Like the name says, this genre brings together trap music, a type of hip hop that came out of Atlanta and heavy metal"
